Name: diversity_bonus_search
Title: Diversity-Bonus Tree Search: Encouraging Novel Solutions in LLM-Powered ARC Solving
Experiment:
1) Edit experiment.py implementing
   - tokenize(code): split on non-alphanumerics, drop stopwords
   - jaccard(s1,s2) and code_similarity(c1,c2)
   - grid_similarity(g1,g2)=fraction_equal_cells; returns 1 when shapes differ
   - novelty_bonus(item, history, mode) where mode∈{'code','output'}; bonus = 1-max_similarity.
2) In experiment.py define global list code_history (and output_history if mode=='output'). After each GenerationResult, extract python code or first demo-output grid; compute bonus, then blended_score = (1-alpha)*public_score + alpha*bonus when --diversity_mode!='off'. Append the new representation to history. Public score itself is left untouched for logging.
3) Extend argparse with --diversity_mode {off,code,output} (default off) and --diversity_alpha FLOAT (default 0.3). Pass these via partial() to generate_fn.
4) Run StandardMCTS with diversity_mode='off' (baseline) and 'code' (α=0.3) on all tasks, 16 nodes each, recording private accuracy and number of distinct solutions (similarity<0.7).
5) Evaluate: Does diversity bonus yield higher private accuracy or more tasks solved within fixed budget? Analyse solved-per-dollar as secondary metric.
